title: Chapter 669 - 669 Encountering Zhao Ting; Victory (2)
content:
Chapter 669 - 669 Encountering Zhao Ting; Victory (2)

Chapter 669 - 669 Encountering Zhao Ting; Victory (2)

669 Encountering Zhao Ting; Victory (2)

As for whether this would break the rules of the competition or affect the progress of the competition, Lin Fan did not consider it at all.

The only thing Lin Fan thought about was that he could not let Xia Xue suffer any harm.

However, before Lin Fan could make a move, Xia Xue suddenly jumped up and directly dodged the attacks of the round-faced woman and the oval-faced woman.

The round-faced woman and the oval-faced woman looked up at Xia Xue who was flying in the air, their faces showing a touch of surprise.

No, they were not the only ones surprised.

Many people outside the arena looked over and exclaimed.

“There’s actually someone flying in Arena 30!”

“Heavens! A special ability to fly!”

“Isn’t this too amazing?”

…

Flying was an amazing thing no matter which era it was.

After Li Ke heard the voice, he also cast a strange look at Xia Xue.

…

Xia Xue, who was flying in the air, had a cold expression on her face.

“You guys are too sinister!”

The oval-faced woman did not mind and said, “In the group arena, it’s either you win or lose. How is there anything sinister about it?”

At this moment, she had already recovered from her shock.

So what if Xia Xue could fly?

At most, she would not attack her.

The other party consisted of two people, so Xia Xue did not have the ability to attack them.

With this thought, the oval-faced woman and the round-faced woman both relaxed.

Xia Xue said coldly, “Either you win or you lose? Since that’s the case, then you guys lose!”

As soon as she finished speaking, Xia Xue jumped down.

She was as fast as lightning.

In the blink of an eye, she arrived behind the oval-faced woman.

The oval-faced woman wanted to dodge, but it was too late.

With a punch, the oval-faced woman was knocked off the arena.

Then, Xia Xue jumped and quickly arrived in front of the round-faced woman. She suddenly kicked.

The round-faced woman also fell off the stage.

Complete victory!

…

At this point, only Xia Xue was the only one left in the entire Arena 30!

She had obtained nine points by herself!

Xia Xue looked at the other arenas and then slowly walked down.

Lin Fan smiled. “Not bad!”

In fact, it was normal for Xia Xue to do this.

When they were in the forbidden area, Lin Fan had specially conditioned Xia Xue’s body and secretly let her absorb a lot of energy.

How could it be difficult for her to deal with two ordinary students?

After Xia Xue heard Lin Fan’s praise, her pretty face blushed slightly. She was very happy.

Even when she defeated the two women and obtained nine points, she was not this happy.

“Thank you.”

At this moment, Tian Zhiwu slowly walked over.

There were some injuries on his body, and his entire face was extremely ugly.

“Sigh, I’m participating in this joint examination in vain.” Tian Zhiwu sighed. “Zero again!”

Lin Fan smiled. “The most important thing is your participation!”

“I can only think of it this way,” Tian Zhiwu said.

“What do you mean by that?” Behind him, Li Dongqiang’s carefree voice sounded.

Tian Zhiwu said, “The most important thing is participation… By the way, how was your group arena?”

“It’s alright. I only scored four points,” Li Dongqiang said proudly.

This was indeed something to be proud of.

One had to know that there were only ten people in each arena, so there was a total of nine points to be won.

4 points was already almost half of the points!

Tian Zhiwu immediately gave him a thumbs-up and said, “Awesome!”

Li Dongqiang waved his hand.

“Group 51 to 100, get onto the arenas!” Li Ke shouted.

Tian Zhiwu said, “Lin Fan, you can do it!”

“You can do it!” Li Dongqiang said.

Xia Xue whispered, “Good luck…”

After a pause, she said, “Be careful.”

Lin Fan smiled. “Alright.”

Why would Lin Fan need to pay attention to his safety?

With his physique, even if he stood on the spot and let others hit him, it was impossible for anyone to cause him any harm.

The referees walked up to the respective arenas.

Lin Fan had just walked onto Arena 61 when he felt a cold gaze on him.

He raised his head and saw Zhao Ting with long bangs.

Zhao Ting grinned. “Lin Fan, what a coincidence. We meet again.”

It was as if he could already see Lin Fan getting beaten up by him.

Lin Fan’s expression remained indifferent.

After all, a small ant was baring its teeth at a human.

How could the human take it to heart?

…

Tian Zhiwu’s expression changed slightly.

“Oh no! Why is Lin Fan on the same arena as Zhao Ting? Zhao Ting’s air control is very difficult to deal with. Moreover, his special ability has reached C-!

“This time, Lin Fan is in danger!”

Li Dongqiang’s expression was also a little solemn as he said, “Lin Fan… He has to be careful.”

Li Dongqiang and Zhao Ting had a short fight before.

It was because of this that he knew very well how difficult it was to go against a user with air control and how powerful Zhao Ting was.

Xia Xue said seriously, “Lin Fan will be fine.”

Her beautiful eyes were fixed on Arena 61 without blinking.

At this moment, a loud and clear voice sounded from the scene.

“The match begins!”

Instantly, everyone in the arenas started moving.

Zhao Ting, who was in Arena 61, charged straight at Lin Fan.

He wanted to rub Lin Fan’s face on the ground to vent the anger in his heart.

“Fall!”

Zhao Ting punched out at Lin Fan.

However, when he was only a few centimeters away from Lin Fan, his fist could not move any farther.

This feeling… It was as if there was an invisible wall in front of him.

Then, Lin Fan followed up with a punch.

This punch landed heavily on Zhao Ting’s face.

Suddenly, Zhao Ting’s entire body seemed to have been hit by a speeding car. His entire body flew out and smashed fiercely under the arena, stirring up a cloud of dust.

Score!

This scene shocked Group 61 and the others.

Everything had changed too quickly. Lin Fan’s attack was way too powerful.

In Arena 61, the eight people who were originally wary of each other suddenly gathered together.

Then, they looked at Lin Fan warily.

This was the instinctive behavior of the weak when they encountered the strong.

“Let’s finish him off together first!” someone whispered.

“Alright!” The remaining people responded.

Then, the eight of them used their special abilities and attacked Lin Fan from different angles.

It was difficult for one to against eight.

However, it was only difficult for ordinary people.

Lin Fan was obviously not ordinary!

His figure was like an illusion, constantly flashing among the eight people.

A series of muffled sounds could be heard from Arena 61.

Following that, all eight of them were like sandbags as they flew backward and landed below the arena.

The match in Arena 61 ended.

Lin Fan scored nine points!

This scene was witnessed by everyone outside the arena.

Many people exclaimed in admiration and discussion.

“Just… Just now, what exactly happened in Arena 61?”

“Why did they suddenly fly out?”

“One minute? Did the match in Arena 61 last more than a minute?”

“This… It’s too fast!”

…

Li Ke turned his gaze to Lin Fan.

He muttered in his heart, ‘Lin Fan? Is this a… coincidence?’

…

Lin Fan did not care about the praises and questions of the crowd.

After he jumped off the arena, he walked straight ahead.

“Lin Fan, wait no!” Tian Zhiwu exclaimed. “Mr. Lin! What is the level of your special ability? Oh my god! All nine of them were defeated by you in the blink of an eye!

“Zhao Ting was also among them. He’s a C-class special ability user!

“Could it be that you’ve reached B+ like Lei Hu?! Heavens! Why re all the people called Lin Fan so awesome?”

Lin Fan smiled. “I don’t know what level I am.”

He was not spouting nonsense.

This was because he did not know how special abilities were classified in the current world.

Naturally, he did not know what level he was at.

Li Dongqiang gave him a thumbs-up.

Xia Xue said excitedly, “Lin Fan, I knew you could do it.”
